Витамин K1.about: Vitamin K1: in MA the effect on cardio-metabolic factors is limited (HOMA-IR, CRP), in K2 the effect is more pronounced; bone data from reviews of K as a whole.
Витамин K1.caution: Metabolic effect is limited; Abstract data on the safety of high doses are sparse; If there is a clotting disorder, consult a doctor.
Витамин K1.dosage: Dosages of K1 are not given separately in the abstracts.
Витамин K1.food_sources: Leafy greens (spinach, cabbage, broccoli), green vegetables, vegetable oils; K1 is predominantly a plant source.
Витамин K1.guidelines: MA 2024 (17 RCT): vitamin K reduces HOMA-IR (WMD -0.24), other - no; MA 2019 (13 RCT): CRP and sensitivity index only; review 2008: K1 and K2 are associated with BMD and fractures.
Витамин K1.how_to_choose: Choose the form according to the purpose: metabolic effects are stronger in K2; K1 - common food phylloquinone; without indications, the benefit has not been proven.
mechs: decrease in HOMA-IR (MA 2024, WMD -0.24), the effect is stronger in K2
decrease in CRP (MA 2019, p=0.01), other factors unchanged
K1 and K2 in bone metabolism
association with BMD and reduction in fractures (2008 review)
Витамин K1.myths: “K1 and K2 are interchangeable” - different forms. “Helps coagulation of all” - effect in newborns. “The supplement will improve bones”—data from dialysis patients. “Needed by everyone” - no data.
Витамин K1.name: Vitamin K1
Витамин K1.onset: The timing of the effect has not been established: in MA 2024, a decrease in HOMA-IR was noted when taking vitamin K as part of the RCT.
Витамин K1.title: Vitamin K1
Витамин K1.who_needs: In case of impaired insulin sensitivity, the effect is small and is stronger in K2 than in K1; in the elderly, for bones - data on K1+K2, primarily MK-4; There is no benefit shown for healthy people.
